text_en: Now the wife of a member of the company of prophets cried to Elisha, “Your servant my husband is dead; and you know that your servant feared the Lord, but a creditor has come to take my two children as slaves.”
text_cn: 有一个先知弟子的妻子，前来哀求厄里叟说：“你的仆人，我的丈夫死了，你知道你的仆人是一个敬畏上主的人；现在债主前来，要带走我的两个孩子，作他的奴隶。”

text_en: Elisha said to her, “What shall I do for you? Tell me, what do you have in the house?” She answered, “Your servant has nothing in the house, except a jar of oil.”
text_cn: 厄里叟对她说：“我能为你做什么？你告诉我：你家里还有什么？”她答说：“婢女家里除一瓶油外，什么也没有。”

text_en: He said, “Go outside, borrow vessels from all your neighbors, empty vessels and not just a few.
text_cn: 厄里叟说：“你去，到外面向你所有的邻居借些空器皿，不要少借；

text_en: Then go in, and shut the door behind you and your children, and start pouring into all these vessels; when each is full, set it aside.”
text_cn: 然后回家，关上门，你和你的儿子在家里，将油倒在所有的那些器皿内，把装满了的，放在一边。”

text_en: So she left him and shut the door behind her and her children; they kept bringing vessels to her, and she kept pouring.
text_cn: 她于是辞别厄里叟，回去照办。她和她的儿子关上门，儿子给她递器皿，她只顾倒油，

text_en: When the vessels were full, she said to her son, “Bring me another vessel.” But he said to her, “There are no more.” Then the oil stopped flowing.
text_cn: 器皿都装满了，她对儿子说：“再递给我器皿！”儿子答说：“没有了。”同时油也止住了。

text_en: She came and told the man of God, and he said, “Go sell the oil and pay your debts, and you and your children can live on the rest.”
text_cn: 妇人就去告诉天主的人。厄里叟对她说：“你去把油卖了，还你的债；剩下的，你和你的儿子可用来过活。”

text_en: One day Elisha was passing through Shunem, where a wealthy woman lived, who urged him to have a meal. So whenever he passed that way, he would stop there for a meal.
text_cn: 有一天，厄里叟路过叔能，那里有一个富贵的妇人，曾挽留他吃饭；因此，厄里叟每次路过那里，总到她家里吃饭。

text_en: She said to her husband, “Look, I am sure that this man who regularly passes our way is a holy man of God.
text_cn: 妇人对丈夫说：“现在我看出：这个时常路过我们这里的天主的人，是位圣者。

text_en: Let us make a small roof chamber with walls, and put there for him a bed, a table, a chair, and a lamp, so that he can stay there whenever he comes to us.”
text_cn: 我们可以在房顶上，给他盖一间小房，里面放一张床，一张桌子，一把椅子和一盏灯；这样，他几时来到我们这里，可在那里休息。”

text_en: One day when he came there, he went up to the chamber and lay down there.
text_cn: 一天，厄里叟又到了那里，就进入那间小房休息。

text_en: He said to his servant Gehazi, “Call the Shunammite woman.” When he had called her, she stood before him.
text_cn: 厄里叟吩咐自己的仆人革哈齐说：“你叫这位叔能妇人来。”仆人叫了妇人来，妇人站在先知面前，

text_en: He said to him, “Say to her, Since you have taken all this trouble for us, what may be done for you? Would you have a word spoken on your behalf to the king or to the commander of the army?” She answered, “I live among my own people.”
text_cn: 厄里叟吩咐仆人说：“现在你对她说：看，你照顾我们既然这样周到，我们可为你作什么事呢？要不要我们在君王或军长前为你说句话？”那妇人答说：“我住在我本国人民中很平安。”

text_en: He said, “What then may be done for her?” Gehazi answered, “Well, she has no son, and her husband is old.”
text_cn: 厄里叟就问革哈齐：“我们究竟能为她作什么？”革哈齐说：“可怜她没有儿子，丈夫又老了。”

text_en: He said, “Call her.” When he had called her, she stood at the door.
text_cn: 厄里叟说：“快再叫她来！”仆人又将妇人叫来，这次她却站在门口，

text_en: He said, “At this season, in due time, you shall embrace a son.” She replied, “No, my lord, O man of God; do not deceive your servant.”
text_cn: 厄里叟对她说：“明年这时，你必怀抱着一个儿子。”妇人答说：“我主，天主的人哪！不会！你别哄骗你的婢女！”

text_en: The woman conceived and bore a son at that season, in due time, as Elisha had declared to her.
text_cn: 这妇人果然怀了孕；过了一年，在厄里叟对她所说的时候，生了一个儿子。

text_en: When the child was older, he went out one day to his father among the reapers.
text_cn: 孩子渐渐长大，一天，他出去到收割的人那里找他父亲，

text_en: He complained to his father, “Oh, my head, my head!” The father said to his servant, “Carry him to his mother.”
text_cn: 孩子忽然对他父亲喊说：“我的头啊！我的头啊！”他父亲吩咐仆人说：“把孩子送到他母亲那里去！”

text_en: He carried him and brought him to his mother; the child sat on her lap until noon, and he died.
text_cn: 仆人将他抱起，送给他母亲，孩子坐在母亲膝上，到了中午，就死了。

text_en: She went up and laid him on the bed of the man of God, closed the door on him, and left.
text_cn: 他母亲遂上了楼，将孩子放在天主的人的床上，关上门，出来，

text_en: Then she called to her husband, and said, “Send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys, so that I may quickly go to the man of God and come back again.”
text_cn: 叫自己的丈夫来说：“请你给我派一个仆人，牵一匹驴来，我要快去见见天主的人，就回来。”

text_en: He said, “Why go to him today? It is neither new moon nor sabbath.” She said, “It will be all right.”
text_cn: 她丈夫说：“为什么今天要去见他，既不是朔日，又不是安息日？”妇人答说：“你放心好了！”

text_en: Then she saddled the donkey and said to her servant, “Urge the animal on; do not hold back for me unless I tell you.”
text_cn: 于是，她把驴备好，对仆人说：“你快赶着走，我若不吩咐，在路上不要停下来。”

text_en: So she set out, and came to the man of God at Mount Carmel. When the man of God saw her coming, he said to Gehazi his servant, “Look, there is the Shunammite woman;
text_cn: 妇人于是来到加尔默耳山见天主的人。天主的人自远处看见她，就对自己的仆人革哈齐说：“看，那是叔能妇人！

text_en: run at once to meet her, and say to her, Are you all right? Is your husband all right? Is the child all right?” She answered, “It is all right.”
text_cn: 现在你跑去迎接她，向她问安说：你好吗？你的丈夫好吗？你的孩子好吗？”她回答说：“好。”

text_en: When she came to the man of God at the mountain, she caught hold of his feet. Gehazi approached to push her away. But the man of God said, “Let her alone, for she is in bitter distress; the Lord has hidden it from me and has not told me.”
text_cn: 妇人上到山上，来到天主的人跟前，就抱住他的脚；革哈齐前来想推开她，可是天主的人说：“由她吧！因为她心中很痛苦；上主隐瞒了我，什么也没有告诉我。”

text_en: Then she said, “Did I ask my lord for a son? Did I not say, Do not mislead me?”
text_cn: 那妇人说：“我何尝向我主求过一个儿子？我岂不是说过：你不要哄骗我吗？”

text_en: He said to Gehazi, “Gird up your loins, and take my staff in your hand, and go. If you meet anyone, give no greeting, and if anyone greets you, do not answer; and lay my staff on the face of the child.”
text_cn: 厄里叟对革哈齐说：“你束上腰，手里拿着我的棍杖前去；不论遇见谁，不要向他请安；不论谁向你请安，你也不要回答。你去把我的棍杖放在孩子的脸上。”

text_en: Then the mother of the child said, “As the Lord lives, and as you yourself live, I will not leave without you.” So he rose up and followed her.
text_cn: 孩子的母亲说：“我指着永生的上主及你的性命起誓：你不去，我决不离开。”厄里叟就起身跟她去了。

text_en: Gehazi went on ahead and laid the staff on the face of the child, but there was no sound or sign of life. He came back to meet him and told him, “The child has not awakened.”
text_cn: 革哈齐在他们以先去了。将棍杖放在孩子的脸上，但是没有声音，没有反应；他便回来见厄里叟，告诉他说：“孩子没有醒来。”

text_en: When Elisha came into the house, he saw the child lying dead on his bed.
text_cn: 厄里叟一来到她家，看见孩子死了，躺在自己的床上，

text_en: So he went in and closed the door on the two of them, and prayed to the Lord.
text_cn: 就进去，关上门，房内只有他和孩子；先知先哀求了上主，

text_en: Then he got up on the bed and lay upon the child, putting his mouth upon his mouth, his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands; and while he lay bent over him, the flesh of the child became warm.
text_cn: 然后上床，伏在孩子身上，自己的口对住孩子的口，自己的眼对住孩子的眼，自己的手按住孩子的手，屈身伏在孩子身上，孩子的肉身便渐渐温暖了。

text_en: He got down, walked once to and fro in the room, then got up again and bent over him; the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
text_cn: 然后他下来，在屋内来回走了一趟；又上去，屈身伏在孩子身上，对着孩子呵了七口气，孩子就睁开了眼睛。

text_en: Elisha summoned Gehazi and said, “Call the Shunammite woman.” So he called her. When she came to him, he said, “Take your son.”
text_cn: 厄里叟叫革哈齐来，对他说：“你叫那叔能妇人来。”他便去叫那妇人，妇人就来了。厄里叟说：“抱起你的孩子来！”

text_en: She came and fell at his feet, bowing to the ground; then she took her son and left.
text_cn: 妇人一进来，就俯伏在他脚前，叩首至地；然后起来，抱起自己的孩子出去了。

text_en: When Elisha returned to Gilgal, there was a famine in the land. As the company of prophets was sitting before him, he said to his servant, “Put the large pot on, and make some stew for the company of prophets.”
text_cn: 厄里叟又来到基耳加耳，那地方正遭受饥荒；众先知的弟子坐在他面前，他吩咐自己的仆人说：“你在火上放上一个火锅，给众先知的弟子煮些菜汤。”

text_en: One of them went out into the field to gather herbs; he found a wild vine and gathered from it a lapful of wild gourds, and came and cut them up into the pot of stew, not knowing what they were.
text_cn: 有一个弟子出去到田间采菜，看见一棵野葡萄树，从上面采了一满兜野果子回来，切碎放在菜锅里，并不知道是什么东西。

text_en: They served some for the men to eat. But while they were eating the stew, they cried out, “O man of God, there is death in the pot!” They could not eat it.
text_cn: 以后，他们把菜汤倒出来给众人吃。众人一尝这菜汤，都喊叫说：“天主的人，锅里有致死的毒物啊！”众人都不能吃。

text_en: He said, “Then bring some flour.” He threw it into the pot, and said, “Serve the people and let them eat.” And there was nothing harmful in the pot.
text_cn: 那时厄里叟说：“拿点面来！”他把面撒在锅里说：“倒出来给众人吃吧！”锅里就再没有什么毒了。

text_en: A man came from Baal-shalishah, bringing food from the first fruits to the man of God: twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in his sack. Elisha said, “Give it to the people and let them eat.”
text_cn: 有一个人从巴耳沙里沙来，在自己的行囊里，给天主的人带来了初熟大麦作的二十个饼和一些新麦穗。厄里叟说：“分给众人吃吧！”

text_en: But his servant said, “How can I set this before a hundred people?” So he repeated, “Give it to the people and let them eat, for thus says the Lord, ‘They shall eat and have some left.’”
text_cn: 仆人说：“我怎能将这一点东西摆在一百人面前呢？”厄里叟说：“你尽管分给众人吃，因为上主这样说：众人吃了，还有剩余。”

text_en: He set it before them, they ate, and had some left, according to the word of the Lord.
text_cn: 于是仆人将食物摆在众人面前，他们都吃了，并且还有剩余，全应验了上主的话。
